bias.zh: 看空 · 重回 200 日均线上方，受制于 $405–411

read.en: TSMC rose 1.5% on Nov 3 to $404.80, trading between $403.03 and $408.37. It is below the falling 5-day ($416.2), 10-day ($420.5), 30-day ($440.1) and 100-day ($429.4) averages and just above the rising 200-day ($400.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($438.39), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 台积电 11月3日上涨 1.5%，收于 $404.80，盘中区间 $403.03–408.37。股价位于下行的 5 日（$416.2）、10 日（$420.5）、30 日（$440.1）和 100 日均线（$429.4）下方，略高于上行的 200 日均线（$400.8）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$438.39），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 200-day ($400.8) and the Oct 30 low ($400.1), now support; the $408.4 high stalled inside the $405.2–411.1 resistance. Resistance is $405.2–411.1 (June, August and October lows), then $416.2–420.5 (5 and 10-day) and $428.4–429.4. Support is $398.2–400.8 (200-day, Oct 30, Nov 2 and Aug 3 lows), then $381.3–388.8 and $372.7. A close above $411 would target $416–420; below $398, $386–388.

s.en: 200-day average $400.8; Oct 30 low $400.1, reclaimed; Nov 2 low $398.3; Aug 3 low $398.2
Jul 17 low $386.0; Jul 30 low $387.6; Jul 27 low $388.8; Jul 28 low $381.3
